decisions.reason: Fitting the document within the page limit does not change the required section sequence or permit section reordering.
The page-limit goal does not remove or modify the requirement to incorporate the organization chart.
The client attributes the length largely to spacing and does not authorize omitting or changing required narrative content.
The page-limit goal does not cancel or alter inclusion of the budget sheet and supplied proposal tables.
The source does not state that the table of contents should be removed or changed to satisfy the page limit.
The source does not modify the required photo-selection or integration rules.
Page-limit compliance does not change the Agua Arc brand identity, colors, or logo requirements.
The source concerns the current RFQ document's page limit and does not alter the deferred future modular-template requirement.
The layout requirement remains valid unchanged; page-limit compliance is separately represented by the source Requirement and does not supersede any current layout attribute.
Reducing document length does not alter the requirement that all hyperlinks remain functional in the saved file.
Although spacing may be adjusted, the source does not change the required consistency of typefaces or font sizes.
The page-limit goal does not change Canva ownership, editing access, asset restrictions, or source-deliverable requirements.
